name: neon-core-android
description: Neon Core Android app (Capacitor). The game itself lives in ../web.

scripts.sync: npm run sync-web && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:release: node scripts/sync-web.mjs --release && npx cap sync android
scripts.build: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:release: npm run sync:release && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
